title: FORTE: A Production Framework for Feature Evaluation and Deprecation in Industrial Recommender Systems
abstract: arXiv:2610.13806v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Production recommender systems have feature-lifecycle asymmetry: adding new features must produce gains on some metric, while feature removal must not regress any metric. In practice, feature deprecation is hard to prioritize as a feature can fail to be removed if it interacts with other features, its importance changes daily, it cannot be evaluated before production models change or data drift occurs, it is in contention for A/B test space with other launches, it causes regressions in an online A/B test, or it is consumed by multiple models that need to coordinate its deprecation. We present FORTE, a model-agnostic production framework for discovering, validating, and removing features. Its efficient perturbation implementation allows daily feature evaluation. translated_title: FORTE：一个用于工业推荐系统中特征评估与淘汰的生产级框架
translated_abstract: 生产环境的推荐系统存在特征生命周期的不对称性：添加新特征必须在某些指标上产生收益，而移除特征则不能使任何指标发生退化。在实践中，特征淘汰难以被优先考虑，因为一个特征可能在以下情况下无法被移除：它与其他特征存在交互作用、其重要性每天都在变化、在生产模型变更或数据漂移发生之前无法对其进行评估、它与其他发布项目争夺A/B测试空间、它在在线A/B测试中导致指标退化，或者它被多个需要协调其淘汰的模型共同使用。我们提出了FORTE，一个与模型无关、用于发现、验证和移除特征的生产级框架。其高效的扰动实现支持每日特征评估。为了考虑特征交互作用，它通过分组消融来评估从所有低秩特征构建的候选特征集，其离线结果足够预……
tldr: FORTE是一个与模型无关的生产级框架，通过高效的扰动实现支持每日特征评估，并利用分组消融处理特征交互，从而实现工业推荐系统中特征的系统化发现、验证与淘汰。
en_tdlr: FORTE is a model-agnostic production framework for discovering, validating, and removing features in industrial recommender systems, enabling daily feature evaluation through efficient perturbation and handling feature interactions via grouped ablation.
